description_zh: 批量删除站点监控的任务
name: DeleteTasks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site monitoring task. The ID uniquely identifies the task
parameters.help_zh: 站点监控的任务Id，任务的唯一标识
parameters.name: task_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the alert rules associated with the task. Default value: 1.

Valid values:
1: Deletes the alert rules at the same time.
0: Does not delete the alert rules. Only the task is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除任务关联的报警规则，默认值为1。

1:同时删除报警规则
0:不删除报警规则，只删除任务
parameters.name: is_delete_alarms
